claude_proposed_widenings.name: feature_augmentation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Eldritch Master is not independently activated. It modifies the outcome of another named class feature when that feature is used. The current class-feature families only cover passive grants, standalone activations, or composites of those, not feature-chained augmentation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: refund_spell_slots
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rule's payload is a full refund of the Pact Magic spell-slot pool. No existing effect atom or class-feature mechanics variant expresses replenishing a named spell-slot pool, and this must stay distinct from generic spell access or action-grant effects.
